1JN.1.1-2.text: John says he saw, heard and touched the eternal life

1JN.1.3-4.text: John writes so believers will join in fellowship with God

1JN.1.5-7.text: God is light, so believers must walk in the light

1JN.1.8-10.text: Believers who confess sins are forgiven by God

1JN.2.1-3.text: Jesus is the sacrifice for the sins of the whole world

1JN.2.4-6.text: Believers must obey Jesus and live as he lived

1JN.2.7-8.text: John writes about an old commandment that is also new

1JN.2.9-11.text: Anyone who hates a fellow believer is in the darkness

1JN.2.12-14.text: John writes to children, fathers and young men

1JN.2.18-19.text: John says the last hour has come and antichrists left

1JN.2.20-21.text: Believers have an anointing from God and know the truth

1JN.2.22-23.text: Whoever denies the Son also denies the Father

1JN.2.24-26.text: John urges believers to keep the first teaching

1JN.2.27-29.text: Believers can be confident when Christ appears

1JN.3.1-3.text: Believers will be like Christ when he appears

1JN.3.4-6.text: Christ takes away sin; believers should not keep sinning

1JN.3.7-8.text: The Son of God came to destroy the devil’s works

1JN.3.9-10.text: Those born of God do what is right and love believers

1JN.3.11-12.text: John tells believers to love, not to be like Cain

1JN.3.13-15.text: Believers who love have passed from death to life

1JN.3.16-18.text: Believers should love with actions, not only words

1JN.3.19-22.text: Believers who obey God can ask him with confidence

1JN.3.23-24.text: God commands believers to trust Jesus and love each other

1JN.4.1-3.text: John tells believers to test every spirit

1JN.4.4-6.text: Believers are from God and have overcome false prophets

1JN.4.7-8.text: Believers should love one another because God is love

1JN.4.9-10.text: God showed his love by sending his Son for our sins

1JN.4.11-14.text: God remains in believers who love one another

1JN.4.15-16.text: Whoever confesses Jesus as God’s Son remains in God

1JN.4.17-18.text: Perfect love drives out fear of punishment

1JN.4.19-21.text: Whoever loves God must also love other believers

1JN.5.1-3.text: Loving God means keeping his commands, which are not hard

1JN.5.4-5.text: Faith in Jesus as God’s Son overcomes the world

1JN.5.6-8.text: The Spirit, the water and the blood testify about Jesus

1JN.5.9-10.text: Whoever does not believe God’s testimony calls God a liar

1JN.5.11-12.text: God gave eternal life, and this life is in his Son

1JN.5.13-15.text: John writes so believers can be sure of eternal life

1JN.5.16-17.text: Believers should pray for a believer who sins

1JN.5.18-19.text: God protects believers, but the world is under the evil one

1JN.5.20-21.text: Jesus is the true God; John tells believers to avoid idols
